scientific_integrity: A direct proof is supplied for every integer complex dimension, all fixed disk sizes, and all real weight parameters above the disk-size scale. Classical beta/gamma eigenvalue formulas are credited. Proof results, not finite tests, support the infinite-dimensional conclusions.
scientific_limitations: Centered balls only; no nonradial symbols
Dimension and disk-size parameters are fixed in the limit
Comparison uses the explicitly specified normalized-monomial unitary
Unindexed equivalent prior results remain possible
title: Positive trace-class Bergman-to-Fock disk scaling and its sharp spectral staircase
